nodes.label: Accessibility Inspect (Manual Tier)
nodes.rationale: Semi-automated manual tier: keyboard operation, focus order, screen-reader names/roles/states from a11y tree, reflow/zoom, reduced motion, form errors, target size. Locates and assesses; does not fix.

nodes.label: Inspect Ledger (verified/flagged/N/A/not exercised)
nodes.rationale: Every criterion in checkpoint areas ends in exactly one state: verified/flagged/N/A/not exercised. Not exercised = undetermined, never silently dropped or passed as pass.

nodes.label: Evidence Budget
nodes.rationale: Verified = full proof gathered once. Flagged = one selector, one screenshot, handoff note, then stop. Human-required = zero driving. Grade bounds evidence worth gathering.

nodes.label: Batched Keyboard Walk
nodes.rationale: Traverse focus in a single evaluate_script call; compute tabbable sequence, focus each element, return compact JSON per stop (selector, role/name, activeElement confirmation, focus outline/box-shadow, bounding box, overlay rect check). Deterministic DOM fact, ●-citable.
